solutions.title: Descending symbol table
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly append the largest Roman token that fits into the remaining value.

timeComplexity.explanation: The value range and symbol table are fixed, so the loop has a bounded number of appends.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output size is bounded by the fixed Roman numeral input range.

solutions.title: Place-value lookup arrays
solutions.strategy: Choose the precomputed Roman fragment for each decimal place and concatenate thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones.

timeComplexity.explanation: Exactly four place lookups are performed.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The lookup tables and bounded output use constant space.
